'''Adsila''' was a character in Old [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] mythology. One of four sisters, Adsila controlled the inevitable dissension and uncertainty of life. The [[Adsila Rifts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] was named after her.<ref name="BSS" />
